title: Hims & Hers Invests in Arboretum to Scale Precision Medicine for Common Diseases

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
CEO Andrew Dudum is seeking to move the medical industry toward a proactive healthcare model by providing patients with tools to identify health risks before symptoms emerge. To support this, Hims & Hers has become a strategic investor in Arboretum LifeSciences, a venture that uses artificial intelligence and genetic testing to expand the use of precision medicine to patients with heart disease, diabetes, and neurodegeneration.

Arboretum was developed through the GV incubator and is led by GV General Partner Anthony Philippakis. The firm currently works with providers and health systems to shift precision medicine away from a primary focus on rare diseases and cancer, with Hims & Hers intending to help extend these innovations beyond traditional clinical settings.

selectedTweets.text:
Today, I’m so proud to share that we're a strategic investor in Arboretum LifeSciences, a next-generation molecular information company. They’re combining genetic testing and AI to scale precision medicine to more conditions and more people.

Since meeting the Arboretum team, I have been looking for ways to be a part of getting their innovation into more hands for one simple reason. Giving people the tools to understand their risk before symptoms develop is how you transform a sickcare system into a healthcare system.

Understanding your own risk should be a normal part of care, not the exception. It’s the future of health that I believe in and it’s what Hims & Hers is all about. Health that gets smarter over time, adapts with you, and puts actionable information in your hands.

This goes beyond rare diseases and can fundamentally change how common conditions like heart disease, diabetes, and neurodegeneration are managed. Today, Arboretum is working with health systems and their providers, and I’m excited for the day that this kind of innovation extends beyond the traditional system (more to come here from us).

Congrats to Anthony, Clare, and the entire Arboretum team!
